1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with a light-activated MTP affixed thereto, wherein the MTP is responsive to light activation for identification purposes.

2. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube and configured to respond to light activation.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards upon light activation.

4. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube configured for long-term storage of biological samples.

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer and is light-activated.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

13. (Currently Amended) A system for storing samples comprising the assembly of claim 1, and one or more of the following: a rack for biorepository test tubes with integrated light-activation capability; an automated robot for moving racks or biorepository test tubes equipped with light-activation readers; and an automated sampling device adapted to sample said racks or biorepository test tubes using light-activation technology.

14. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 adapted for low temperature operation, wherein the racks and test tubes are handled and maintained at -20°C or less during storage and retrieval operations.

15. (Currently Amended) A method of forming a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: heating a light-activated MTP to above the melting point of plastic; and melting a portion of the plastic with the heated MTP to embed the light-activated MTP therein.

16. (Currently Amended) A method of reading an embedded light-activated MTP in a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: providing an embedded light-activated MTP; and reading the MTP using light activation.

17. (Original) The method of reading of claim 16, wherein the embedding material is frost coated.

18. (Original) The method of claim 16, wherein the reader comprises a vial receptacle and wherein the vial receptacle and the embedded MTP are maintained at a temperature of -20°C or less.

19. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is a light-activated MTP embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer.

20. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

21. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards upon light activation.

22. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

23. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the light-activated MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards upon light activation.
